units.source_text: 人力车从砖屋大街通过，转向回家方向的巷子。

en.t: The rickshaw passed along Brickhouse Street and turned into the alley leading toward home.

units.source_text: 突然，路上碰见了哥哥英吉。

en.t: Suddenly, on the road, we ran into my elder brother Eikichi.

units.source_text: 哥哥手上拎着一盏油灯——油灯上有煤熏成的竹子图案，正匆忙赶路。

en.t: My brother was carrying an oil lamp in his hand, a lamp with a soot-blackened bamboo pattern on it, and was hurrying along.

units.source_text: 一看到我，便举起油灯示意“等一下”。

en.t: As soon as he saw me, he raised the oil lamp to signal, Wait a moment.

units.source_text: 德藏的动作很是灵敏，一边转动车辕，一边把车停在了哥哥身旁。

en.t: Tokuzo moved with great agility, turning the shafts as he brought the rickshaw to a stop beside my brother.
